scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && concurrently "npm run dev:shared" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=client
